weeklyUnreadTip: This week's mirror report is ready — click to read
onboardBarHint: Routine training not started — pick an identity for base anchors, then 3 quiet observation days

onboardBarReady: {t} observation days done — first mirror report ready

onboardConstraintsTitle: Step 2 · Reality constraints (optional) — state wake/sleep; the draft projects from reality (e.g. up at 11 → first draft 10:30)

onboardLowConfHint: Low confidence = no stated wake time; the first weekly report must re-check these items.
onboardFrozenHint: ✅ Baseline frozen — you're in the training loop: nightly handoff meetings as usual; the first draft is scheduled for tomorrow, then rolled forward daily.
onboardPickTail: Click a card to continue; you can go back and re-pick anytime — nothing is written until you start.

calRemindChannelsHint: Reminders are decoupled from data: on-time alerts come via in-app toast / dialog toggles, independent of board data.
